verification.subject: Your Velio verification code
verification.heading: Confirm your email
verification.intro: Enter this code in Velio to finish creating your account.
verification.ignore: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

password_reset.subject: Your Velio password reset code
password_reset.heading: Reset your password
password_reset.intro: Enter this code in Velio to choose a new password.
password_reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and your password will stay the same.

account_delete.subject: Your Velio account deletion code
account_delete.heading: Delete your account
account_delete.intro: Enter this code in Velio to confirm. Your account, your saved routes and your requests are erased for good.
account_delete.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and your account will stay as it is.
